summary: A dataset reference now reads its source at the period the grid is shown at, so the position in the reference means what it looks like on screen.
details: A reference typed into a yearly grid takes yearly figures from a source held monthly instead of that source's first months.
A source that cannot be shown at the grid's period is refused with the reason rather than answering with its own rows.
The ArcRhoVec and ArcRhoTri function forms still name their own period and are unchanged.
